instructions: Compare baseline.json upstream blob hashes before merging overlays. Preserve any newer unrelated changes. Do not overwrite a whole repository with this partial source tree.
No dependency installation, environment credentials, publication or migration execution is included or authorized by these overlays.
Back up production databases through the normal release process. Apply both additive migrations; retain these ledgers permanently. Rollback must disable the feature, never delete replay history.
Deploy activation-license controller, routes and redemption migration together. The legacy activate route must acquire the same license row lock to avoid racing new claims.

Deploy subscription credit controller, config, route and credit migration together. Configure the activation-service basic-auth credentials server-side through the existing secret-management process, never in the desktop app.

Redeem routes require service basicAuth and throttling; the user-facing desktop route requires a scoped user token and independently resolves ownership. Do not expose internal routes without middleware.

Exclude redemption bodies/headers from application, proxy and APM logs, including global telemetry. Verify global telemetry configuration in deployment; do not send activation codes or Basic credentials to APM.

Run concurrent MySQL tests with the deployed database engine and approved staging credentials, including simultaneous legacy/new claims, duplicate credit and failure/restart recovery. SQLite tests do not prove production row-lock behavior.

Deploy desktop API with STELLAR_ACTIVATION_ENABLED=false first. Enable it only after both backend endpoints are available, migrations and staging tests have passed. There is deliberately no fallback to the old consuming endpoint.

Upgrade other UI APIs separately if they should benefit from resumable redemption. Legacy callers retain their old two-step credit flow; this change only serializes their license consumption against the new path.
Do not test with real activation codes or deploy without separate explicit approval. Desktop itself can be rebuilt/restarted without enabling activation server-side.
known_constraints: Existing VPN subscription required; no subscription is created by redemption.
A receipt permanently binds a code to one account and subscription. Ownership transfers or deleting that subscription require an operator recovery policy, not reusing the receipt elsewhere.
Receipt/credit is a recoverable two-service protocol, not a distributed atomic transaction. Interrupted progress resumes when the same code is submitted again.
Existing public license verify/activate routes are not expanded or newly exposed by this patch; assess their legacy authentication/rate-limiting separately.
